title: Retain nine BIT arrival price floors with arbitrary rational relay charts
body:
**The nine original rank-seven BIT arrivals into chart 0 retain minimum price `7^t` even with arbitrary new rational relay charts**, for `0<t<=1`. New charts have zero initial scratch and no new source information; original earlier stock, retention and local XOR are free, and every nested transfer is charged. This closes the new-chart opening in [PR #7750](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7750) for these nine deadlines. **No new kappa**, whole-word relay theorem or additive lower bound for a shared multi-output network is claimed.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9fda92fea5ed634471df177c27f1f74eeea5a166/research/bit-rational-relay-price-floor/PROOF.md), [complete pair certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9fda92fea5ed634471df177c27f1f74eeea5a166/research/bit-rational-relay-price-floor/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9fda92fea5ed634471df177c27f1f74eeea5a166/research/bit-rational-relay-price-floor/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9fda92fea5ed634471df177c27f1f74eeea5a166/research/bit-rational-relay-price-floor/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9fda92fea5ed634471df177c27f1f74eeea5a166/research/bit-rational-relay-price-floor/CREDITS.md).

The proposed dimension-three hub cannot gather the required original dimension-four stocks: among all **2,415 distinct pairs**, intersections have dimension zero or two, never three. More generally, subspace distance makes any tree joining chart 0 to three original dimension-four charts cost at least eight, even through arbitrary new subspaces. A cheaper network has total rank at most six, so its relevant component contains at most two such stocks. Its support is at most **42**, or at most **35** when it reaches an original dimension-six stock. Every target-coset representative has weight at least **48**.

```text
delta(A,B) = dim(A)+dim(B)-2 dim(A intersect B)
three original four-spaces plus zero: tree cost >= 8
cheaper target network: rank sum <= 6, support <= 42 < 48
```

| Evidence | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| Complete four-space geometry | 70 charts, 2,415 pairs: 1,155 intersections of dimension zero and 1,260 of dimension two |
| Separate rank paths | Integer elimination and rank modulo the verified prime 1,000,003 agree on every pair |
| Retained source replay | All stock supports, 511 target cosets, paid-row/source attainments and the complete nested-chain bound |
| Scope control | A changed coordinate geometry really admits the proposed rank-six star; its common three-space fails the actual source pair premise |
| Rejection controls | A duplicate pair and all three changed-geometry source pairs fail the required distance floor |

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-rational-relay-price-floor
```

Both registered normal and optimized commands print:

```text
PASS_BIT_RATIONAL_RELAY_PRICE_FLOOR 2415 pairs; support<=42<48
```

Normal/optimized registered replay, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44403700757/job/135153170502) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence. The general new-chart conclusion follows from the metric and information-component proof, not a finite sampling of possible rational charts.

Ali Romman supplied the [fixed-chart proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bd2684e60d122e7c490f0b4fbceb97742584b773/research/bit-nine-deadline-relay-floor/PROOF.md), [chain certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bd2684e60d122e7c490f0b4fbceb97742584b773/research/bit-nine-deadline-relay-floor/RESULT.json) and [PR #7741](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7741)'s quotient/coset result. Nick Petalas supplied [PR #7739](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7739)'s original reduction and nine exceptions. [PR #7723](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7723) supplied the fixed-library model; Jerry Chen supplied the selected [PR #7001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7001) caller. The [retained credit file](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bd2684e60d122e7c490f0b4fbceb97742584b773/research/bit-nine-deadline-relay-floor/CREDITS.md) preserves zxv, DreamingOfClouds, Cinna Davis and earlier native/root attribution. All source bytes and notices remain intact.

Each conclusion concerns one original target and its fixed original earlier stock. The nine minima cannot be summed for a jointly changed network that creates shared earlier information. The other 5,733 arrivals, new source promises, changed rows/deadlines and uncharged cross-chart operations need separate analysis. No physical construction for free storage or new-chart access is supplied. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged. The selected cold replay, unrelated historical suites, Lean, Docker and physical relay execution were not run.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, revision 8. The complete 28-file predecessor package is retained at `bd2684e60d122e7c490f0b4fbceb97742584b773`; its nested source pins remain intact. No unmerged source ancestry is asserted. Geometry preparation and source replay remain shared code; the separate rank paths check the new pair certificate only.
